script_core: Simple SuperSite that still looks premium
headline_line_1: A simple SuperSite that still feels
pitch_headline: A SuperSite built for smaller operators with clean early trust signals.
pitch_body: This version of the SuperSite is tuned for smaller pool operators: enough polish to feel premium, enough simplicity to feel believable, and enough structure to turn clean reviews into real opportunity.
section_title: A SuperSite that upgrades the first impression fast.
section_copy: Even with lower review volume, the site can still feel established if it presents the work clearly and keeps the homeowner experience simple.
video_section_body: A short transformation clip helps a smaller operator feel more credible without overcomplicating the page.

why_cards.title: Clean first impression
why_cards.body: A smaller operator can still feel premium when the site is calm, clear, and visually strong.

why_cards.title: Review quality over volume
why_cards.body: Lower review count is workable when the reviews are strong and the presentation is confident.

why_cards.title: Simple but elevated
why_cards.body: The goal is not complexity. It is a cleaner front door that feels more serious than the usual local option.
